opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 15 December for a decision in March

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds.
opportunities.summary: Small grants are awarded as ‘seed funding’ to enable projects that might otherwise not be possible without our support, focusing on projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, encourage the exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between our two nations.
